component.name: UpSTEPer
component.summary: View, colour, repair and convert STEP CAD models
STEP-CAD-Modelle ansehen, einfärben, reparieren und umwandeln

description.p: UpSTEPer opens 3D CAD models in the STEP format (AP203, AP214, AP242) and takes care of the everyday chores around them, without a CAD licence:

ul.li: View models with their assembly tree, standard views and edges
Colour faces and bodies, with the RAL Classic colours, and save as STEP
Check and repair badly exported models, keeping their colours
Export 2D views with hidden lines as DXF

description.p: The command-line tool is included: flatpak run --command=upsteper io.github.mattheuserb.UpSTEPer
